title.value: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan (Short-term (PE)), FY2027 2nd recruitment
title.evidence_quote: Application Schedule (Short-term (PE)・Open Call)｜Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan

institution.name: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)

qualifications: For researchers from the US, Canada and Europe
Holders of professional degrees such as a JD or MD are not eligible unless they also hold a PhD
Applications go through a Japanese host institution, whose internal deadline may be a month or more earlier than JSPS's
Arrival in Japan between August 1, 2027 and March 31, 2028
description_short: JSPS Short-term (PE) postdoctoral fellowships let researchers from the US, Canada and Europe carry out research in Japan with a host. For the FY2027 2nd recruitment, hosts submit to JSPS by 8 January 2027; about 20 awards, results mid-May 2027.
